answer: Bind each agent key to a single privacy-preserving uniqueness proof: a zero-knowledge check that one real credential backs this identity, without revealing the credential itself. One person can anchor one agent; a farm would need a distinct genuine credential for every fake, turning free minting into a costly procurement hunt. Any second key reusing the same proof is rejected outright, and the umber trail of a rejected duplicate becomes a fable other operators learn from, while honest agents keep a steady pulse of activity without ever exposing who they are.
